# Pacta (by Fractal Neurons)

> Block-pinned control-plane snapshots and pre-execution timelock alerts for DeFi collateral. 14 Sprints · 37 Indexed Records.

Pacta checks who can change the rules of DeFi protocols (proxy admins, timelock delays, Safe quorums, roles) and compares that with what the protocols document. Every record is a read-only on-chain observation pinned to an Ethereum Mainnet block number and canonical block hash.

## Data
- [https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/index.json](https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/index.json): schema `pacta.counterparty_control_index.v1`; `summary_metrics` (sprints_completed=14, records_indexed=37, parameter_deltas=14, protective_deltas=4, aligned_baselines=19); each entry has id, protocol, category, sprint, block_number, block_hash, classification, surface, target_contract, target_label, check_type, selector_or_slot, call_signature, call_args, repro_calldata, onchain_observed, documented_reference, observed/documented delay seconds, summary_doc, summary_sha256, base_eas_uid.
- [https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/radar.json](https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/radar.json): queued timelock operations, refreshed at finalized block 26406890 (2026-11-13 15:18 UTC).

## Live pre-execution briefs
- [https://pacta.wtf/briefs/ethena-ops-0x0ca0-0x1fe5/](https://pacta.wtf/briefs/ethena-ops-0x0ca0-0x1fe5/): Pre-execution brief: two queued Ethena timelock operations onboard RLUSD and USAT to EthenaMinting at 200M / 20M USDe-per-block caps (1-day delay; ETAs 2026-11-14 10:20–10:22 UTC).
- [https://pacta.wtf/briefs/etherfi-op-0x244e/](https://pacta.wtf/briefs/etherfi-op-0x244e/): Pre-execution brief: ether.fi operation 0x244e…359f moves the EtherfiL1SyncPoolETH LayerZero V2 delegate behind the 10-day EtherFiTimelock (ETA 2026-11-20 16:54 UTC).
- [https://pacta.wtf/briefs/treehouse-op-0x2f11/](https://pacta.wtf/briefs/treehouse-op-0x2f11/): Pre-execution brief: a queued 5-day timelock operation upgrades the Treehouse TREE token (not tETH) and installs a 5-of-7 Safe blacklister (ETA 2026-11-17 04:51 UTC).
- [https://pacta.wtf/demos/swapio-x402/](https://pacta.wtf/demos/swapio-x402/): 90-second x402 storyboard (TreasuryGuard) with a live, on-chain-verified Base USDC settlement receipt.

## Methodology
- Scanner seats replay read-only eth_call / eth_getStorageAt at the cited block (two independent archive RPCs); an isolated verifier seat re-checks selectors, EIP-55 checksums, EIP-1967 slots and arithmetic offline.
- Classifications: parameter_delta (on-chain differs from docs), protective_delta (a change that strengthens controls), aligned_baseline (on-chain matches docs).
- Exploit-sensitive vulnerabilities are never published here. They go through the protocol’s Immunefi or Cantina bounty programme, or to a partner audit firm under a 15% referral partnership.

## Access
- Free and real-time for everyone, including vault curators, allocators and AI risk agents: every indexed record, the timelock radar, the briefs, /api/v1/*.json and this file. No key, no delay, no paywall; curators never pay.

## On-chain anchoring (Base, chain id 8453)
- PactaCommitmentRegistry: `0x35D21Bb4Df6586FE7759b5e57263ffeB3e1fd872` (Sourcify verified); attester `pacta.base.eth` (`0xcA4E2ff22B69A7284210c47BdeE21Aac1269da09`).
- EAS schema: `0x7ff485bc1159dff3c70eefcb9dff2d65be990301760c2d53799e5a45e3badf83`. 16 Base EAS sprint attestations cover Sprints 1–16; Sprints 15–16 records join the public index after review.
- Multi-attest tx, Sprints 1–12: `0x8c53e155a4b2f28ffbf069f1b65952fc8f7d81740f362b8aafb39493c6bd001b`
- Multi-attest tx, Sprints 13–16: `0x11546aac53e3fe57fa6ac9f7e4397f06c58b6803252e099eb9349eca00f2edbf`
- Per-sprint attestation UIDs: `onchain_anchoring.sprint_eas_attestations` in /api/v1/index.json; each record's `base_eas_uid`.

## Engagements (collateral issuers)
- 24h Collateral Onboarding & Delta Clearance Attestation: $5,000 USDC flat (optional continuous Aligned badge maintenance: $1,500 / month). Canonical block-pinned control-plane audit, GitBook / config reconciliation PR, Base Mainnet EAS Aligned attestation in PactaCommitmentRegistry, and a Curator Diligence Dossier (PDF + JSON) for Morpho, Euler, Aave and Sky forum proposals. Clears open parameter_delta flags or onboards a new asset.
- Payment: USDC on Base (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`) or Ethereum (`0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48`) to the Pacta treasury `0x4348DF1BEFAffcbA248B5118B1b782B1B2bdEd14` (same address on both chains).
- Community queue: free, unscheduled (typically 6–8 weeks).
- Request: https://pacta.wtf/request/ (builds a scope brief; opens a pre-filled GitHub intake issue or Gmail compose, or copies the brief).

## x402 API (planned, not live)
- On-demand scans of contracts outside the index; the indexed data above stays free. Planned endpoint: https://api.pacta.wtf (deployment pending; not yet live). Routes: `GET /v1/scan/control-plane?chain=&address=` ($0.10), `GET /v1/scan/timelock-op?timelock=&opId=` ($0.25); free `/health`, `/.well-known/x402`, `/v1/sample/control-plane`.
